text: Hello Abbu, it's Ayesha. How is your day going?
Oh Ayesha, I'm very well today. I walked in the garden this morning and the roses are blooming.
That sounds lovely. Did you have breakfast?
Yes, parathas and tea. Your cousin Imran dropped by and we laughed for an hour.
I'm so glad. Anything planned for later?
I will watch the cricket match this afternoon and then take a nice nap.
Sounds perfect, Abbu. I'll call again soon.
God bless you, beta. I feel good today.
